items.title: Classification on the Basis of Reactions (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Classification on the Basis of Reactions: a main subheading of 5.7 Classification of enzymes, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 139-140.

blocks.text: Reaction ki aam qisam ke lihaz se enzymes chhe classes mein baante gaye hain.

items: Oxidoreductases: yeh enzymes apne substrates ka oxidation ya reduction karwate hain. Yeh substrates mein H⁺ ions ya electrons shamil karte ya un se nikalte hain. Maslan cytochrome oxidase cytochrome ka oxidation karwata hai.

Transferases: is class ke enzymes ek khaas functional group (maslan methyl, acyl, amino ya phosphate) ko ek substrate se doosre substrate tak muntaqil (transfer) karte hain. Maslan hexokinase ATP se phosphate group le kar glucose ko deta hai.

Hydrolases: yeh enzymes hydrolysis reactions karwate hain, yani pani mila kar apne substrates ko monomers (chhoti ikaiyon) mein torte hain. Maslan lipase, amylase, peptidase aur doosre digestive (hazme ke) enzymes khuraak ke molecules ki hydrolysis karte hain.
Lyases: yeh enzymes pani ke baghair (non-hydrolytic) substrates mein groups (maslan CO₂, NH₂) shamil karte ya un se nikalte hain. Maslan pyruvate decarboxylase pyruvic acid se CO₂ nikalta hai.

Isomerases: yeh enzymes molecule ke andar atoms ki nayi tarteeb (intra-molecular rearrangement) karte hain, yani ek isomer ko doosre isomer mein badalte hain. Maslan hexose isomerase glucose ko fructose mein badalta hai.

Ligases: yeh enzymes un reactions ko karwate hain jin mein do molecules naye C-C, C-N, C-O ya C-S bonds bana kar jurte hain, aur is ke liye ATP ki tawanai lagti hai. Maslan DNA ligase ATP ki tawanai se DNA ke do tukron ko jorta hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ligases ki misal polymerase enzymes deti hai. Polymerases ligases nahi, transferases hain: DNA aur RNA polymerases nucleotide triphosphates ko monomer aur energy dono ke tor par istemal karte hain, alag ATP nahi. Ligase ki sahi misal DNA ligase hai jo ATP ki energy se DNA ke do tukron ko jorta hai. Oopar yahi misal likhi gayi hai.
